note: Real data from the SKAB pump rig. The shaded band is the fault labelled by SKAB.

alerts.title: Fluid temperature rising unusually fast, confirmed by vibration A
reasons: 2 signals are outside their limits at the same time, which a single faulty sensor cannot cause.
alerts.cause: Change in heat balance: cooling, friction or fluid temperature.
alerts.action: Inspect the motor cooling and fluid circuit on pump P-101 this shift. Assembly and Packing depend on this station.
alerts.truth: Overlaps a fault labelled in SKAB.
